description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different query complexities—simple, moderate, and challenging—as well as a total average. The horizontal axis represents the query complexity categories: “Simple”, “Moderate”, “Challenging”, and “Total”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Execution Accuracy”, displays a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each complexity category, there are two bars representing the two models. The lighter gray bars represent NatSQL, and the darker teal bars represent TA-SQL. For the “Simple” category, NatSQL has a bar of approximately 60.21, while TA-SQL has a bar of approximately 63.14. In the “Moderate” category, NatSQL’s bar reaches approximately 39.64, and TA-SQL’s reaches approximately 48.60. For “Challenging” queries, NatSQL’s bar is around 32.32, and TA-SQL’s is approximately 36.11. Finally, for the “Total” average, NatSQL’s bar is at 51.35, and TA-SQL’s is at 56.19. The bars are arranged in adjacent pairs for each complexity level, with NatSQL consistently positioned to the left of TA-SQL. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
